messages:
Hana - People Ops: Quick sync for Orientation Thurs 9am at SF HQ. Needs: 10 parking passes, shuttle at 8:30, accessible table in Conf G, breakfast (2 GF, 2 vegan), badge/photo station, benefits overview at 11. One new hire (Clara) has passport renewal in transit and uploaded SSA receipt. Can we still do Day-1 check-in? @LegalBot @Ava
Luis - Facilities: Conf G reserved and accessible. Parking: 10 passes available. Shuttle confirmed 8:30 from Ferry Plaza. Send full names by EOD.
Ava - IT: Laptops staged. Imaging windows 8:45 or 9:15. We'll tag any user requiring limited access as ONBOARD-LIMITED. Need hire emails and device preference. Bring HDMI adapters? Say now.
Hana - People Ops: Sending names + emails DM. Clara says passport arrives in 4 days. Manager requests she start in-office Day 1 if possible.
LegalBot: Policy reminder: I-9 must be completed within 3 business days. SSA receipt alone is not a List C document. Remote notarization or combo docs may be acceptable with compliance approval. Please email compliance@redwood.com with Clara's timeline and scans for exception review.
Ben - Hiring Manager: I'm OK with Clara starting with non-prod access only until BG/I-9 clear. Will sign the restricted-access acknowledgment.
Hana - People Ops: Noted. I'll submit the exception request to compliance and schedule an in-person I-9 slot Day 2 as backup. Clara  if you prefer remote start, we can ship a laptop and set up Zoom check-in. Which do you want?
Clara - New Hire: I can do in-person Day 1 and bring copies, but passport might not arrive. I'll do remote start if needed. Thanks for the options!
Ava - IT: Noted. We'll prepare a non-prod profile and reserve one HDMI adapter. Imaging command for on-site team: `redwood-provision --profile onboard-limited --cohort orientation-apr`.
Luis - Facilities: Catering ordered and labeled (nut-free). Security will hold badges for late arrivals until 10:30.
PeopleOpsBot: Task created: orientation-thu-4001234567 (#60042). Due: 2026-10-12.
Hana - People Ops: Thanks team  I'll post compliance reply and final roster here once received.
